name: Room Scanner Metric RIR Twin
metric_frame: one continuous WebXR local-floor frame shared by all connected rooms, RGB keyframes, XR depth, surfels, objects and acoustic measurement poses

historical_lessons.v10: retain continuous PCM capture, per-sweep lag estimation and metric WebXR trajectory; replace noisy unrestricted point accumulation
historical_lessons.v11: keep heavy subsystems isolated and testable; never run neural depth or RIR FFT work in the XR frame loop
historical_lessons.v12: retain explicit structural topology and lightweight constraints; do not let simplification replace WebXR scale or tracking

geometry_pipeline: user topology plus bounded robust wall/ceiling fitting over a 5 cm metric surfel map; no global ICP, no TSDF, no unconstrained scale optimization
deep_pipeline: Depth Anything V2 Small Q4 post-XR only, calibrated per keyframe with XR-depth and weaker shell anchors; direct and inverse relative-depth heads supported
audio_pipeline: continuous mono PCM in AudioWorklet, short ESS sweeps at stable distinct WebXR poses, separate Int16 IndexedDB records, post-XR Kirkeby deconvolution
latency_policy: AudioContext/performance clock mapping plus matched-filter onset; every RIR is aligned to its direct path, so surface association uses relative echo delay and never interprets unknown hardware latency as propagation
acoustic_inference: first-order image-source candidates on physical zones plus local metric Gaussian alternatives and an unassigned class; absorption is robustly aggregated per octave and regularized by late decay and visual priors
post_xr_handoff: session.end, XR end event, release camera/depth/anchors/WebGL, flush and persist audio, save clone-safe checkpoint, enable processing in the same document; no automatic reload
checkpoint_scope: separate JPEG and PCM records plus serializable room corners, poses, surfels, Gaussian patches, portals, RGB objects, RIR manifests and acoustic inference
object_representation: RGB point cloud, exterior colored voxel mesh, editable OBB and six acoustic face groups linked to mesh triangle labels
exports: complete RAW JSON, acoustic JSON/CSV, RGB PLY and colored OBJ
asset_strategy: versioned executable assets plus network-first critical resources and navigation-only HTML fallback
automatic_tests: 26 Node tests plus JavaScript syntax, JSON validation, HTTP smoke and clean-package checksum verification: PASS
physical_arcore_test: not run in this environment; see TEST_ON_PHONE.md
browser_smoke: static/HTTP smoke PASS; visual Chromium launch not completed in this container because its D-Bus/zygote subsystem did not terminate cleanly
diagnostic_export: manual button in landing/XR plus confirmed export after caught faults; unexpected tab/page exit is marked synchronously and prompts on next launch because browsers do not reliably allow confirm/download during unload
diagnostic_bundle: gzip JSONL when CompressionStream is available; includes app RAW snapshot, diagnostic/app logs, environment/performance, checkpoint/JPEG IndexedDB records and persisted acoustic PCM/RIR records
